title: Why Rome Actually Fell (It Is Not What You Were Taught)
description:
Rome did not fall in a single dramatic day. This documentary walks through the six real explanations historians actually argue about: barbarian migration, currency collapse, endless civil war, the east-west split, plague and climate, and the argument that the fall never happened at all. Plus why a fifteen hundred year old collapse still shapes the roads, laws, language and calendar you use today.

0:00 The day the empire ended
1:00 How a farming town became a superpower
3:00 Barbarians, refugees and the Huns
4:30 The money spiral
6:00 Plague and a changing climate
7:30 Civil war and the split
9:00 Why this still matters today

SOURCES
